entities.name: Nicolae Berechet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolae Berechet was a Romanian boxer who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. He was born in Dioști, Dolj County. On August 11, 1936 he was eliminated in the first round of the featherweight class after losing his fight to Evald Seeberg.
